description: 2026-08-30 CAPT-ITLANE, 2.2.0 — SIX STOCK COLUMNS ADDED, and the reason is that the only live IT deviation rule in the whole SSOT could not fire. GET /api/articles is ARTICLE_WITH_STOCK_AND_PRICE_SQL: it already served menge_frei / menge_reserviert / menge_blockiert / verfuegbar / mindestbestand / safety_stock on every one of its 221 rows, and this descriptor mapped NONE of them. The consequence was not a missing column but a misplaced rule: profiles/wms/quant.json carried a literal stock band [20,500] on ONE PALLET's quantity, because the per-article stock position the band is actually about had never been projected. MEASURED on .154:38260 2026-08-30 — 221 rows, mindestbestand present on 219 (values 8..5000, i.e. a PER-ARTICLE threshold, not one constant), safety_stock on 221/221, verfuegbar on 218/221. The three nulls are the honest absence case and the rule reads 'unknown' on them, never 'ok'. RE-OBSERVATION, the property the old pairing lacked, was measured over 21 min of 30 s polls: 0-11 articles change per tick, ~5.5/min, over a BOUNDED and COMPLETE population (it-edge logs fetched=221 keyed=221 tracked=221 populationComplete=true, every 30 s). Contrast sim-v5-wms-quants, whose key carries a mint timestamp so every production event is a NEW key and no entity is ever evaluated twice. Adding these columns makes stock movements PUBLISH (the mapped set is what change detection hashes; before this the poll wrote 0 rows for hours because the 9 mapped master-data columns never move). --- previous description follows. --- 2026-08-18: polling.paginate ENABLED, together with sim-v5-erp-customers (see that descriptor for the full reasoning). it-edge (DATA-7) refused every delete/tombstone pass on this source with reason unpaginated_full_refresh - 60 times in a 30-minute window, unread - so the source could ingest but never RETRACT and an article deleted upstream would have stayed in the KG for ever. paginate could NOT simply be declared: GET /api/articles ignored limit and offset outright. MEASURED against the live ERP .154:38260 with /api/orders as the positive control in the same run: ?limit=5 -> 221 rows, ?offset=9999 -> 221 rows, while /api/orders?limit=5 -> 5. Declaring paginate against that endpoint would have looped to MAX_PAGES=10000 (it-edge stops only on an EMPTY page) - 10k requests per poll, every 30 s - and still returned pagination_truncated. Fixed upstream first: sim-v5 api-erp b06c699c (F-ARTICLES-PAGINATION). VERIFIED on PROD after that deploy: ?limit=5 -> 5, ?offset=9999 -> 0, ?page_size=7 -> 7. Paging exhausts the population exactly - on dev, 221/221 distinct rows at page sizes 10 AND 50, 0 duplicates, 0 missing, ordering monotone; part_number is unique (222 rows / 222 distinct, 221/221 with active = true) and both joins in ARTICLE_WITH_STOCK_AND_PRICE_SQL are 1:1 by construction. THE MECHANISM WAS PROVEN BEFORE THIS COMMIT, not assumed: customers was changed first and went silent while THIS source kept refusing 60 times in the same window - an A/B with a live control. intervalMs deliberately unset, so the poll cadence stays on the 30 s default. batchSize 5000 is the server's MEASURED hard cap.
